escape_asterisks off leaves asterisks in a table cell unescaped

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<table><tr><td>2*3 = 6</td></tr></table>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(escape_asterisks: false))
puts result.content.inspect
```
